post.description:
Create a property listing supporting 99acres flows:
- USER Flow: Individual owner listing directly linked to owner_id.
- AGENT Flow: Broker listing linked to agent_id and optional owner_id.
- BUILDER Flow: Builder listing linked to builder_id and validated project_id.
- ADMIN Flow: Full administrative assignment.
